Self.Wiki: This map object represents an particle emitter in the map.

Unk05.Wiki: ON for 131 emitters. In Elden Ring, a flag passed on when the effect is created; not seen read in Nightreign.

EffectID.Wiki: The SFX ID this emitter produces.

StartDisabled.Wiki: If ON, this particle will be inactive until it is enabled via an event script.
